gizmo.title: External tool launch
gizmo.description: A block that opens an external learning tool in a new window or on the page, as a plain link or with an LTI 1.3 login request.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: Name of the tool. It is shown in the header and on the button.

configure.title: Description
configure.description: What learners do in the tool, shown above the button.

configure.title: Launch URL
configure.description: Address of the tool. It must be a full address that starts with https:// or http://.

configure.title: Open in
configure.description: A new window works with every tool. On this page only works with tools that allow being shown inside another site.

advanced.title: LTI login URL
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 only: the tool's login initiation address. With this, a client ID and a deployment ID the button sends an LTI login request instead of opening a plain link. Finishing the launch needs this site's LTI service.

advanced.title: LTI client ID
advanced.description: The client ID the tool gave this site. A public identifier, not a secret: never put keys or secrets here.

advanced.title: LTI deployment ID
advanced.description: The deployment ID the tool gave this site. A public identifier, not a secret.

advanced.title: LTI issuer
advanced.description: The address that identifies this site to the tool. Leave empty to use the address of the site the page is on.

advanced.title: Height on the page
advanced.description: Height of the tool when it opens on this page, in pixels (200 to 2000).

advanced.title: Accent color
advanced.description: Color of the header chip and the button. Leave empty to follow the theme.

developer.title: LTI login hint
developer.description: An opaque value this site's LTI service uses to recognize the learner. Usually supplied by the site through the lti-launch-request event rather than saved here. Never a password or key.

developer.title: LTI message hint
developer.description: An opaque value this site's LTI service uses to recognize this launch. Usually supplied by the site rather than saved here.

properties.title: Lab 4 autograder
properties.description: Submit your code to the autograder. It runs the tests and shows your results.
